characters.name: Aylin
characters.clueEn: She was beside a trash can. She was in the same area as the only woman office owner.
characters.clueZh: 她在垃圾桶旁边。她和唯一的女性办公室主人在同一区域。

characters.name: Beatriz
characters.clueEn: She was in the Cubicles area. She was not with Flora or Kaleb.
characters.clueZh: 她在工位区。她既不和 Flora 在一起，也不和 Kaleb 在一起。

characters.name: Carter
characters.clueEn: He was not sitting in a chair. He was with the CEO.
characters.clueZh: 他没有坐在椅子上。他和总裁在一起。

characters.name: Esther
characters.clueEn: She was sitting in a chair in an Office. She was not in the CEO's Office.
characters.clueZh: 她坐在某间办公室的椅子上。她不在总裁办公室。

characters.name: Flora
characters.clueEn: She was exactly one row south of an office owner.
characters.clueZh: 她正好在一位办公室主人南边一行。

characters.name: Grant
characters.clueEn: He was sitting in a chair in the top row.
characters.clueZh: 他坐在最上面一行的椅子上。

characters.name: Hans
characters.clueEn: His column was not adjacent to Dillard's column.
characters.clueZh: 他所在的列与Dillard所在的列不相邻。

characters.name: Irene
characters.clueEn: She was in the Hallway. Only one office owner was south of her.
characters.clueZh: 她在走廊。她南边只有一位办公室主人。

characters.name: Jolly
characters.clueEn: There were exactly three office owners who were west of her.
characters.clueZh: 她西边正好有三位办公室主人。

characters.name: Leroy
characters.clueEn: He was in the bottom row. He was not sitting in a chair.
characters.clueZh: 他在最下面一行。他没有坐在椅子上。

characters.name: Monica
characters.clueEn: She was alone in the Conference room.

characters.name: Nina
characters.clueEn: She was not in the Cubicles area.

characters.name: Omar
characters.clueEn: He was in the Kitchen with Aylin or Jolly, who was sitting in a chair.
characters.clueZh: 他和坐在椅子上的Aylin或Jolly一起在厨房。

characters.name: Vincent
characters.clueEn: The Victim. He was alone with the murderer.
characters.clueZh: 受害者。他和凶手单独在一起。

generalClues.text: 办公室的主人共有五位。所有主人都在自己的办公室里，包括总裁。
generalClues.textEn: There are five office owners. All owners occupy their own office, including the CEO.

generalClues.text: 总裁既可以被称为「总裁」，也可以被称为「办公室的主人」。
generalClues.textEn: The CEO may be referred to as both "the CEO" or an "office owner".
